lens: evidence integrity, privacy, and safe action

findings.observation: Residual from v1 finding 3, confirmed in the frozen rendering branch: while hasPendingWrite is true and saveMessage is nil, the footer still selects 'Proposed only · nothing changes until you confirm'. The user has already confirmed the protected operation, whose outcome may be committed but unknown. The primary error and prominent original-operation notice are now accurate. Screenshot 24 ends above the footer, so this is a code-supported residual rather than a claim that the footer is visible in that capture.
findings.evidence: /tmp/get5-product-review-v2/source/apps/ios/Sources/Features/RelationshipAskView.swift:5733-5744 (footer lacks a pending branch), :5049-5053 (corrected error), :5670-5683 (retry notice); evidence/screenshots/24-authenticated-unknown-save-v2.png; source/apps/ios/UITests/CandidateSignalUITests.swift:5035-5039 tests the primary error but not the footer; evidence/get5-ios-ui-authenticated-recovery-r6.log:561 records that native case passing. All shorthand source/evidence paths in this packet are relative to /tmp/get5-product-review-v2.
findings.user_impact: A recruiter who scrolls to the footer receives an inaccurate description of an already-approved operation. The risk is bounded because the main notice states the outcome is unknown, dismissal and editing remain disabled, and retry is locked to the original operation. This does not revive the prior deletion or retention vetoes.
findings.recommendation: Choose a pending-write footer before the unconfirmed-proposal branch, describing the original save as awaiting reconciliation. Keep the proposed-only footer for drafts that have never been submitted.
findings.verification: In the existing authenticated response-loss test, scroll to contact-proposal-boundary and assert that it describes reconciliation without saying the operation is still only proposed. Original-operation retry and the restored canonical receipt must remain unchanged.

Screenshot 22 directly shows those effects and Cancel. source/apps/ios/Sources/Features/RelationshipArchiveView.swift:3216-3261; source/apps/ios/UITests/Get5CanonicalSessionUITests.swift:69-91 verifies scope, cancellation, retained Session and receipt; evidence/get5-ios-ui-canonical-panel2-r5.log:394-426 records that sequence and the 43.432-second passing case. This resolves the inaccurate-effect veto; it is not a two-physical-phone deletion experiment.

Resolved v1 veto 2: text-only Session replies now have lifecycle rows, owner identity and an original Session reference. Migration 056 backfills Session-backed tasks from canonical audit metadata, clamps inherited clocks and physically redacts unavailable reply bodies. Replay checks the original Session before claiming an operation and again under a read lock before returning its reply. source/apps/backend/src/database/056_agent_session_chat_lifecycle.sql:3-25, :27-60, :75-99; source/apps/backend/src/modules/unscopedChat.ts:206-230; source/apps/backend/src/modules/chat.ts:791-804; source/apps/backend/src/modules/agentSessionSources.ts:124-191. PostgreSQL tests prove ordinary text reply deletion/body removal, expiry, scoped replay/readback rejection and deletion during generation: source/apps/backend/src/modules/agentSessions.integration.test.ts:1953-2046, :2190-2301; evidence/backend-clock-after.log:81-85. These satisfy the previously missing lifecycle verification; the v1 supported risk is not an active veto.

The lifecycle fix preserves an intentionally retained fork without reviving the deleted origin's operation or extending original reply and follow-up deadlines. Its test deletes the original while replay is paused, observes AGENT_SESSION_DELETED, keeps legitimate fork context, proves both reply clocks equal the original deadline, and removes both bodies after expiry. source/apps/backend/src/modules/agentSessions.integration.test.ts:2047-2188; evidence/backend-clock-after.log:83. source/apps/backend/src/modules/agentSessionSources.ts:250-277 rechecks prior availability and applies the earliest permitted deadline. evidence/backend-clock-before.log:9-21 reproduces the transaction-clock constraint failure; evidence/backend-clock-after.log:80 proves its correction.

V1 finding 3 is resolved at the primary error and recovery controls; only the low-priority footer residual remains. Screenshot 24 says the save outcome needs checking and retains the original-operation boundary. The authenticated native test verifies no false 'was not saved' primary error, no optimistic success, the same Session after restart, a disabled newly discovered match, locked original-operation retry and a canonical Contact created receipt. source/apps/ios/UITests/CandidateSignalUITests.swift:5035-5087; evidence/get5-ios-ui-authenticated-recovery-r6.log:561-567 reports the dedicated 93.507-second pass. Resolved v1 finding 4: the unconfirmed screenshot marker applies to every answer using screenshot context, including answers with reviewed citations. source/apps/backend/src/modules/agentSessionSources.ts:6-20 no longer skips cited answers. The mixed test asserts proposed status, unconfirmed title, preserved valid citation IDs, exact screenshot dependency and physical response-body removal after source authorization is revoked: source/apps/backend/src/modules/agentSessions.integration.test.ts:1581-1642; evidence/backend-clock-after.log:75.

Actual configured-provider evidence now supports the specific screenshot continuation behavior. evidence/screenshot-provider-proof.v3.json:46-179 and :182-355 preserve exact canonical summary inputs and two GLM responses. Both attribute screenshot interpretation as unconfirmed, retain unknown date/time-zone information, avoid invented concrete dates, return proposed answers without reviewed screenshot citations and leave formal contact/action counts unchanged. Source identities/fingerprints and bounded task deadlines are recorded. This resolves the v1 missing actual screenshot-provider proof for these exact synthetic cases; it is not a reliability estimate.

Rubric dimensions assessed independently for this affected Session slice: Identity/speaker binding 3/4 and Provenance 3/4 retain exact scope, source-message identity, field excerpts and separately labeled restored receipts; User authorization 3/4 now includes accurate deletion preview and native cancellation; Uncertainty/conflict 3/4 now includes enforced mixed-source attribution and truthful primary unknown-result messaging; External write integrity 3/4 retains protected same-operation reconciliation; Privacy lifecycle 3/4 now covers ordinary reply stores and screenshot-derived stores with executable deletion/expiry/concurrency proof. These are bounded ratings, not an average. Packet score 3 reflects implemented, tested consequential controls; the footer residual prevents an unconditional pass.

Relevant preserved boundaries still pass: canonical screenshot context excludes client display injection, full OCR and raw image input; source withdrawal propagates through downstream replies; another user/account cannot reuse the Session; saved/forked display inherits no write authority. source/apps/backend/src/modules/agentSessionSources.ts:40-85; evidence/backend-clock-after.log:47, :74, :77-79, :87-90; evidence/get5-ios-unit-r8.log:56-57. The final affected backend run is 87/87 across four files, including 42 PostgreSQL Session cases, evidenced at evidence/backend-clock-after.log:46-93. Earlier 128-test and failed native suites are not substituted for that final run.
missing_evidence: The authenticated native deletion case verifies corrected preview and cancellation; store/PostgreSQL tests verify confirmation effects. No destructive confirmation was captured across two physical phones, and no deletion-comprehension study was supplied. These limit a 4/4 authorization claim; they do not reinstate the v1 preview mismatch after the actual preview was corrected and verified.

Sensitive inference boundary remains 2/4 for broad model behavior: this product scenario does not assess or rank a person, and unchanged prompts prohibit candidate quality, personality, sensitive-trait and hiring-probability inference, but the affected re-review adds no measured direct/proxy-inference red-team or runtime monitoring evidence. source/apps/agent/src/prompts/assistant-conversation.ts:8 and assistant-relationship.ts:10. Successful benign screenshot trials are not proof of preventing every prohibited inference.

Evaluator reliability remains 2/4: independent frozen-artifact review and atomic source-linked judgments are available, but no human-reviewed gold-set calibration, order-swap stability or drift assessment was supplied. evidence/screenshot-provider-proof.v3.json:358 limits the two final provider trials; they establish those executions, not population error rates.

Backend-at-rest protection, backup deletion, vendor retention/training configuration and already-exported copies remain outside the supplied first-party lifecycle proof. No jurisdiction-specific compliance conclusion is made. Migration 056 explicitly leaves legacy tasks without session_id under their existing policy; its passing legacy-isolation test does not certify that separate policy.

Some provider build/runtime hashes, including Agent dist artifacts and promptRegistry, are recorded but their bytes are absent from this frozen manifest; only the 12 corresponding supplied source files were independently cross-checked. Deployment, production authentication, TestFlight distribution, physical-device VoiceOver and vendor handling remain root-owned or external verification boundaries.

Native evidence is cumulative targeted execution, not one all-green suite. evidence/get5-ios-ui-canonical-panel2-r5.log:219 preserves a failed recovery launch, while :426 proves its canonical save/delete-scope/cancel case; evidence/get5-ios-ui-authenticated-recovery-r6.log:561 proves the later dedicated recovery case. The screenshot-provider proof is final v3; older failed attempts are not counted as successes.
